_about: Per-fragment / per-article mode declaration. The gate aggregators (run-gate-a.sh, c-constitution.sh) read this file to decide whether a failing fragment fails the gate (BLOCKING) or only logs (REPORT). Modes change as their owning dispatch lands. See scripts/gates/EXPECTED-FAILURES.md for the human-readable timeline and .ai-coder/governance/GATE-AMENDMENTS.md for the amendment process. This file is the machine-readable source of truth.

a-cross-source-cancellation-policy.rationale: Bug 1170/1198 fixed; cancellation_policies table is the single source of truth.

a-cross-source-brand-color.rationale: Bug 1324 fixed; mobile theme.ts uses canonical #1B3A4B.

a-cross-source-routes.rationale: Bug 1185 (static paths) fixed in D02 Part 4. Backtick template-string router calls deferred to D12 per LAUNCH-LIMITATIONS §routes-registry-template-strings.

a-cross-source-tier-criteria.rationale: Bug 1323 fixed; founding tier criteria server-canonical.

a-cross-source-no-axios.rationale: Bug 1271 fixed for clients (admin in D01, mobile in D02 Part 5). Scope: apps/ only — server outbound axios excluded by design.

a-cross-source-no-emoji-icons.rationale: Phase 13 baseline shows 1089 absolute / 412 introduced; per-screen polish in D11/D12 replaces all emoji with lucide. Promotes to BLOCKING after D12.

a-cross-source-hashes-immutable.rationale: Preventive: HASHES-CORRECTED.sha256 files (when added) must not be modified. Currently no such files exist; gate is vacuously passing but locks the rule in.

a-cross-source-no-client-money.rationale: Bug 175/176/208/261 — server validators accept money fields. Owned by D05 (Money trust closure). Promotes to BLOCKING after D05.

a-cross-source-no-siguradoshield.rationale: Bug 538 — SiguradoShield references in 6 mobile customer surfaces + platform.config.ts:54-57 constants. Owned by D04 (Option A pull). Promotes to BLOCKING after D04.

article-4.2-no-console.rationale: Console.* in production code is cleaned progressively across D01-D12 mobile/admin polish. Promotes to BLOCKING after D12.

article-4.6-no-emoji.rationale: Overlaps with Gate A no-emoji-icons (redundant by design). Same timeline.

article-7.1-no-axios.rationale: Scope corrected in D03 to apps/ only (matches Gate A's a-cross-source-no-axios). Server-to-server outbound axios in packages/api/src/services/{payment,sms}.service.ts is out of scope for this gate.

article-12-bigint-money-tests.rationale: bigint-money-precision.test.ts already exists with 5+ tests (Phase 13 Dispatch E).

article-16-closeout-exists.rationale: Activates per dispatch branch. Always BLOCKING when running on a phase/14-dNN-* branch.

money-in-transaction.rationale: Bugs 69, 70, 71, 78, 79, 80, 82, 83, 84, 85, 105, 106, 127, 237 — 14 services with money mutations outside db.transaction(). Owned by D06 (Transactional audit completeness). Promotes to BLOCKING after D06.

gate_d_state.rationale: Visual baselines populated progressively: D07 admin + designer-grade restyle, D08 mobile, D11/D12 per-screen baselines. d-visual-screenshots.sh already skips cleanly when baseline directories are empty.

gate_e_state.rationale: Mutation score baseline at 99.3% from Phase 13 partial run. D12 promotes to BLOCKING. e-mutation-testing.sh already skips when no production files changed (this dispatch's pattern for meta-only dispatches).
